statements.text: Frappe framework auto-generates REST CRUD endpoints for all DocTypes; POST /api/resource/:doctype creates a new document by accepting JSON in the request body.
Authentication is performed via token (api_key:api_secret), password/session cookie, or OAuth bearer access_token; roles are checked against the authenticated user.
Lead DocType catalog includes email_id (Data, Email options), company_name, lead_owner (Link→User), status, and numerous other fields.
Runtime ABI declares available client-controlled paths /request/body (object) and /request/body/email_id (string) only; it supplies no policy condition, expected decision, or evaluation label.
